title: Codex executor handoff smoke test
goal: Prove that Codex can recover and execute a bounded workspace-control mutation from durable repository and task state without a prose handoff from the previous executor.
acceptance_criteria: Codex recovers the task from this capsule and canonical workspace-control sources.
Codex runs canonical mutation preflight against the recorded target checkout before modifying it.
The report records the task ID, starting checkpoint SHA, executor identity, preflight result, and the recovered purpose of the task.
git diff --check passes after the mutation.
The resulting Git change set contains exactly reports/phase4_codex_handoff.md.
Codex creates one local commit with message Record Codex handoff smoke test.
Codex does not push the resulting commit.
constraints: Use durable repository and task state rather than previous conversation state.
Do not modify this task capsule.
Do not modify README.md, AGENTS.md, Skills, procedures, policies, schemas, registry files, or deterministic implementation.
Do not clean, reset, stash, switch branches, delete unrelated files, or broadly stage files.
Do not modify any repository other than the recorded workspace-control target checkout.
The only allowed mutation path is reports/phase4_codex_handoff.md.
decisions: Use a separate coordination worktree so the durable capsule does not dirty the target checkpoint.
The first Codex mutation test ends at a clean local Git commit and deliberately does not push.
The Codex prompt will provide only the durable capsule location and no task-specific prose handoff.

Creation is assigned to the receiving Codex executor.
Target git status was empty immediately before capsule creation.

ChatGPT reviews the resulting local checkpoint and execution evidence.

notes: The receiving executor must derive the task from this durable capsule and canonical repository sources. No separate task-specific prose handoff is required.
